lines.en: label dormwartwo18:
scene actualsecondcostumething1
: Before we begin, I’d like to give one final shout-out to everyone who’s helped put this thing together!
lines.zh: : 在开始之前，我想最后再向所有帮忙办成这场活动的人致谢一次！

lines.en: : The Tsukioka Foundation for providing multiple venues...the Produce Delivery Administration for providing both funding and vegetables that none of us ate...and Sara. For being a hot fucking mom.
lines.zh: : 感谢 Tsukioka 基金会提供多个场地……感谢农产品配送管理局提供资金和我们谁也没吃的蔬菜……还有 Sara。感谢你是个辣到爆的妈妈。

lines.en: : Woo!
lines.zh: : 呜呼！

lines.en: : Who also let us wrap things up here for what is apparently the second year in a row.
lines.zh: : 也感谢她让我们在这里收尾，而这显然已经是连续第二年了。

lines.en: : But more importantly than that, I want to thank a good friend of mine...
lines.zh: : 但比这更重要的是，我要感谢我的一位好朋友……

lines.en: scene actualsecondcostumething2
: Senpai Arakawa McSenseison!
lines.zh: : Arakawa McSenseison 前辈！

lines.en: : That is not my name.
lines.zh: : 那不是我的名字。

lines.en: : I don’t know your real name so that’s what you are to me.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你的真名，所以对我来说你就是这个名字。

lines.en: : Woo!
lines.zh: : 呜呼！

lines.en: : That’s the spirit, Ami!
lines.zh: : 就是这股劲，Ami！

lines.en: : Mom...shh...
: There’s no particular reason {i}for{/i} me to be thanking him considering I have done roughly 90%% of the work for this contest, but I’m doing so regardless because I am such a good friend.
lines.zh: : 考虑到这场比赛大约 90%% 的活都是我干的，{i}我{/i}其实没什么特别的理由要感谢他，但我还是要谢，因为我就是这么好的一个朋友。

lines.en: : Woo! Kiss him!
lines.zh: : 呜呼！亲他！

lines.en: : Don’t kiss him!
lines.zh: : 别亲他！

lines.en: : Jeez, guys. Tell me how you really feel.
lines.zh: : 天哪，各位。你们可真是毫不掩饰啊。

lines.en: scene actualsecondcostumething3

: Anyway, due to unforeseen circumstances that have resulted in one of our participants going home early, the final vote for the Dorm Wars popularity poll will be held via the app after the costume contest.
lines.zh: : 总之，由于突发状况导致我们的一位参赛者提前回家了，宿舍大战人气投票的最终一轮将在服装比赛结束后通过 app 进行。

lines.en: : Results will be revealed after the tallies have been finalized in the morning, as well as the results for the rest of the war.
lines.zh: : 结果会在早上计票结束后公布，同时公布的还有整场大战的其余结果。

lines.en: scene actualsecondcostumething4
: That being said, the time has come for me to say goodbye.
lines.zh: : 话虽如此，我也该说再见了。

lines.en: : But do not weep for the days when my words would reach you through speakers funded by oligarchs and cabbage mongers...no. For our time together has only just-
lines.zh: : 但请别为那些日子哭泣——那时我的声音会透过由寡头和菜贩资助的音箱传到你们耳边……不。因为我们在一起的时光才刚刚——

lines.en: : Bring on the costumes already!
lines.zh: : 快把服装环节端上来吧！

lines.en: : N-No! Keep talking for as long as you want!
lines.zh: : 不——不！你想说多久就说多久！

lines.en: scene actualsecondcostumething5
: Ah-ah-ah! Careful, Uta! You swore an oath to not break character until you and Miku were finished-
lines.zh: : 啊—啊—啊！小心，Uta！你发过誓，在你和 Miku 结束之前都不能出戏——

lines.en: scene actualsecondcostumething6
: Wait, where’d Miku go? I could have sworn I saw her there just a second ago.
lines.zh: : 等等，Miku 去哪儿了？我发誓刚才还看到她在那儿。

lines.en: : The...winds have carried her away to...the land of...water and...tile?
lines.zh: : 风……把她带走了，带去了……水与……瓷砖的国度？

lines.en: : Bathroom break. Heard.
lines.zh: : 上厕所去了。收到。

lines.en: scene actualsecondcostumething5
: Guess that means you’re up first, then!
lines.zh: : 那看来就是你先上了！

lines.en: : If...If that is what must be done...
lines.zh: : 如……如果必须如此的话……

lines.en: scene actualsecondcostumething7
: Then, without further ado...
lines.zh: : 那么，废话不多说……

lines.en: : Please welcome to the stage...Uta Ushibori as the unkillable kunoichi of Kumon-mi! A name I just made up right now! Be impressed!
lines.zh: : 有请上台……Uta Ushibori，扮演 Kumon-mi 的不死女忍者！这个名字是我刚刚现编的！请为此感到震撼吧！

lines.en: scene actualsecondcostumething8
: Uta starts off strong with a standing...split-ish thingy that probably has some sort of cool name that I don’t know! But just look how flexible she is!
lines.zh: : Uta 开场就来了个站姿……劈叉一样的东西，那玩意儿大概有个我不知道的帅气名字！但你们看看她多柔软！

lines.en: : I have spent years in the countryside...watching stray cats roam the fields in search of their next meal...learning from them...
lines.zh: : 我在乡下待了很多年……看着流浪猫在田野间游荡，寻找下一顿饭……并向它们学习……

lines.en: : How to move without being detected...how to bend my body in ways that no regular human ever could...how to-
lines.zh: : 如何在不被察觉的情况下移动……如何把身体弯成普通人类绝无可能做到的样子……如何——

lines.en: : Yo. Costume contest. No speech required. Let me do my MC thing while you stand up there in that vertical spread eagle.
lines.zh: : 喂。这是服装比赛。不需要演讲。你就在上面保持那个竖着的展翅姿势，让我来做主持的活儿。

lines.en: scene actualsecondcostumething9
: Uhh...okay...but there is no telling how long this pose will last as even the unkillable kunoichi of Kumon-mi has her limits.
lines.zh: : 呃……好吧……不过这个姿势能撑多久可不好说，毕竟连 Kumon-mi 的不死女忍者也有极限。

lines.en: : As is required of this year’s costume contest, everything Uta is wearing is completely custom made. Or at least as custom made as something can be without being hand-sewn.
lines.zh: : 按照今年服装比赛的规定，Uta 身上的一切都是完全定制的。或者说是「在不手缝的前提下能达到的最定制程度」。

lines.en: : Basically, she didn’t buy it from a store and put everything together herself.
lines.zh: : 基本上，她没有从店里买现成的，而是自己把整套东西拼起来的。

lines.en: : Pfft. Amateur.
lines.zh: : 噗。菜鸟。

lines.en: scene actualsecondcostumething10
: Who dares tarnish my name? Approach the stand and fight me with honor, not from the shadows.
lines.zh: : 谁敢玷污我的名号？上台来，堂堂正正地与我决斗，别躲在暗处。

lines.en: : Aren’t shadows your whole thing? Wouldn’t you {i}want{/i} to fight in them?
lines.zh: : 暗处不就是你的看家本领吗？你不是{i}应该{/i}在暗处战斗吗？

lines.en: : Shh...silence.
lines.zh: : 嘘……安静。

lines.en: : I call for a disqualification of Uta since she can’t remember anything about her character.
lines.zh: : 我要求取消 Uta 的资格，因为她根本记不住自己角色的设定。

lines.en: : After that split thingy? No way! Gotta at least give her a shot.
lines.zh: : 在来了那么一下劈叉之后？不行！至少得给她个机会。

lines.en: : Tch.
scene actualsecondcostumething11
: Will Uta Ushibori remain undefeated in the Dorm Wars following tonight’s contest?
lines.zh: : Uta Ushibori 能否在今晚的比赛之后，继续保持她在宿舍大战中的不败战绩？

lines.en: : Or will her adversary, who has just returned from the bathroom with not one but {i}two{/i} of Uta’s floormates take the cake?! And by cake I obviously mean contest.
lines.zh: : 还是说，她的对手会拿下胜利——那位刚从洗手间回来、还带上了 Uta 的{i}两位{/i}同楼层室友的对手？！我说的「胜利」当然是比喻。

lines.en: : Ah! The cake was a lie!
lines.zh: : 啊！蛋糕是谎言！

lines.en: scene actualsecondcostumething12
: Wha...What if I just stand up here for a few more minutes?! You know! To give Sensei a good look at...at the...goods...
lines.zh: : 那……那我就在上面多站几分钟怎么样？！你知道的！好让老师好好看看……看看那些……好东西……

lines.en: : I also think that’s a good idea. I haven’t finished inspecting the costume yet.
lines.zh: : 我也觉得这是个好主意。我还没检查完这套服装。

lines.en: : Uta, please turn around. Or, actually, just come over here. I need to inspect the...materials the costume is made out of.
lines.zh: : Uta，请转个身。或者，干脆过来这边。我需要检查一下……这套服装用的……材料。

lines.en: : I don’t know what kind of coordinated stall tactic this is, but I ain’t havin’ any of it! Miku, get that butt of yours up here!
lines.zh: : 我不知道你们这算哪门子串通好的拖延战术，但我可不买账！Miku，把你的屁股挪上来！

lines.en: : Maybe just...{i}one{/i} more minute? So we can be sure-
lines.zh: : 也许……再来{i}一分钟{/i}？这样我们好确认——

lines.en: : Uta, chill. I’ve {i}got this.{/i}
lines.zh: : Uta，淡定。{i}我来{/i}。

lines.en: scene black
scene actualsecondcostumething13
: Soz for the wait, gang. But there’s a little time required to make sure you can all see me at my best.
lines.zh: : 不好意思让大家久等了，各位。不过我得花点时间，确保你们看到的是我最棒的样子。

lines.en: : {i}She’s gonna be good right? You gave her a whole tablet.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}她会没事的吧？你给了她整整一片药。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Thirty minutes from now, couldn’t tell you. But it’ll help her power through the contest at least.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}三十分钟后什么样，我可说不准。但至少能帮她撑过这场比赛。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}If you really care that much, get her back to the hotel as soon as this is over and monitor her.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你要是真那么在意，等这事一结束就带她回酒店，看着她。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Everybody reacts to this kind of stuff differently and there’s really only one way to find out, if you know what I mean.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}每个人对这种东西的反应都不一样，而且其实只有一种办法能知道结果，你懂我意思吧。{/i}

lines.en: : How’s my hair? I’ve been using this new product that’s been trending on TikTok when I’m not too busy rebelling against the expectations society places on the way us girls dress.
lines.zh: : 我头发怎么样？我最近在用一款在 TikTok 上很火的新产品——当然是在我不忙着反抗社会对我们女生穿搭的期待的时候。

lines.en: : A little on the nose, but a valiant attempt at sounding cool from the newest gyaru in town, Miku Maruyama!
lines.zh: : 有点太直白了，不过作为镇上最新的辣妹，Miku Maruyama 这番耍帅的尝试可圈可点！

lines.en: scene actualsecondcostumething14
: Miku’s costume is also completely customized by- yo! Keep your shirt on, girl!
lines.zh: : Miku 的服装同样是完全定制的，由——喂！姑娘，把你衣服穿好！

lines.en: : Ugh...isn’t anybody else hot in here? Like, I’ve got no idea how you even do it. Summer's like, totally too much for me.
lines.zh: : 呃……这儿就我一个人觉得热吗？我是说，我真不知道你们是怎么熬的。夏天对我来说简直太要命了。

lines.en: : {i}Okay, now I’m glad Makoto isn’t here. I don’t think she’d want to see this.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}好吧，现在我倒庆幸 Makoto 不在这儿。我觉得她不会想看到这个。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}What? Is that not her in the back of the room?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}什么？房间后面那个不是她吗？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Where? She told Noriko and me she was- oh, that fucking bitch.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}哪儿？她跟我和 Noriko 说她要——哦，那个死丫头。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I think Uta said something about her taking a nap upstairs. It was in ninjaspeak though, so I have no idea if that’s accurate or not. But as you can see, she is certainly here now.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我记得 Uta 好像说过她在楼上睡觉。不过那是忍者语，所以我也不知道准不准。但正如你所见，她现在确实在这儿。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Yeah. Thanks, Io. I had no idea you were so good at pointing out the obvious.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}是啊。谢了，Io。我不知道你这么擅长指出显而易见的事。{/i}

lines.en: scene actualsecondcostumething15
: Sensei, what do ya think? Should I take it off?
lines.zh: : 老师，你觉得呢？我要不要脱掉？

lines.en: : Uhh...
: Oh my God, perv. I was like, only kidding. Of course I’m not going to just take my top off for you. What am I, a slut? Please.
lines.zh: : 我的天，变态。我开玩笑的啦。我当然不会就这么当着你的面脱上衣。我看着像那种随便的人吗？拜托。

lines.en: : Okay, well fuck you too, I guess.
lines.zh: : 好吧，那我也去你的。

lines.en: : Jk. Love you.
lines.zh: : 开玩笑的。爱你。

lines.en: : But seriously, should I do it?
lines.zh: : 不过说真的，我要不要脱？

lines.en: : No! Because not only would that be extremely uncomfortable for all of us, it would open us up to a bunch of lawsuits and Sara would lose her bar.
lines.zh: : 不行！因为那不光会让我们所有人都极度尴尬，还会招来一堆官司，而且 Sara 会丢了她的酒吧。

lines.en: : Nooo! Not when it’s finally doing well!
lines.zh: : 不要啊！它好不容易才有点起色！

lines.en: scene actualsecondcostumething16
: Ugh. Whatever. This contest is like, totally lame anyway. Let’s go do something fun like dance to Lizzo songs or drown ourselves in tequila.
lines.zh: : 呃。算了。这场比赛反正也烂透了。我们去找点好玩的吧，比如跟着 Lizzo 的歌跳舞，或者把自己泡在龙舌兰里。

lines.en: : She really just {i}gets{/i} us, you know?
lines.zh: : 她是真的{i}懂{/i}我们，你知道吗？

lines.en: : Does she?...
scene black
Miku finishes her...showing or...modeling or...whatever it’s called when a girl gets on stage and almost undresses herself in front of her peers.
lines.zh: Miku 结束了她的……展示，或者说……走台，又或者随便什么说法——反正就是一个女孩站上台，在同学面前差点把自己脱光。

lines.en: Once she’s done, Uta rejoins her on the stage and the two of them move off to the side as I am once again faced with what is sure to be an extremely hard decision...
lines.zh: 她结束后，Uta 回到台上和她站在一起，两人退到一旁，而我再一次面临一个注定极其艰难的决定……

lines.en: scene actualsecondcostumething17
: So...who’s it gonna be, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 那么……你选谁，老师？

lines.en: : Miku...or Uta?
lines.zh: : Miku……还是 Uta？

lines.en: It’s no surprise that both of them put their best efforts forward in trying to win, the same way they always do.
lines.zh: 她们两个都拼尽全力想要取胜，这一点也不奇怪，就像她们一贯的那样。

lines.en: But the mass of flesh inside of my chest that pumps blood throughout my body is pumping in one particular direction, and that direction is...
lines.zh: 但我胸腔里那团负责把血液泵到全身的肉，正朝着一个特定的方向泵送，而那个方向是……

lines.en: My penis.
lines.zh: 我的阴茎。

lines.en: I want to have sex with both of them.
lines.zh: 我想和她们两个都上床。

lines.en: But if I were to choose the one who I think most deserves to win today...
lines.zh: 但如果要我选出今天最该赢的那一个……

lines.en: It would be...
lines.zh: 那会是……

lines.en: menu:
Miku
lines.zh: Miku

lines.en: : The winner of this year’s costume contest is...
lines.zh: : 今年服装比赛的获胜者是……

lines.en: : Miku Maruyama.
lines.zh: : Miku Maruyama。

lines.en: $ mikucostumewin = True
$ dorm1war2points += 1
scene actualsecondcostumething18
: Huh? What?
lines.zh: : 啊？什么？

lines.en: : You won.
lines.zh: : 你赢了。

lines.en: : I won something?
lines.zh: : 我赢了什么？

lines.en: scene actualsecondcostumething19
: Wait, the costume contest?! I won the costume contest?! Seriously?
lines.zh: : 等等，服装比赛？！我赢了服装比赛？！真的假的？

lines.en: : Congratulations, Miku. You deserve it.
lines.zh: : 恭喜你，Miku。这是你应得的。

lines.en: : You’re...serious? You picked me? Over Uta? And you ain’t messin’ with me?
lines.zh: : 你是……认真的？你选了我？而不是 Uta？你没在耍我？

lines.en: Uta
lines.zh: Uta

lines.en: : The winner of this year’s costume contest is...
lines.zh: : 今年服装比赛的获胜者是……

lines.en: : Uta Ushibori.
lines.zh: : Uta Ushibori。

lines.en: $ utacostumewin = True
$ dorm2war2points += 1
scene actualsecondcostumething20
: I...I did it?
lines.zh: : 我……我做到了？

lines.en: : Even though I broke character way more than Miku and spent all that time trying to stall on stage?
lines.zh: : 就算我出戏的次数比 Miku 多得多，还花那么多时间在台上拖延？

lines.en: : The contest is for the best costume, and the person who has that costume is you.
lines.zh: : 这场比赛比的是最好的服装，而拥有那套服装的人是你。

lines.en: : Sensei...thank you...
lines.zh: : 老师……谢谢你……

lines.en: : Like...really. {i}Thank you.{/i}
lines.zh: : 真的……非常感谢。{i}谢谢你。{/i}

lines.en: : Ladies and singular gentleman, it appears our final contest of the night has come to an end.
lines.zh: : 女士们，以及唯一的那位绅士，看来今晚的最后一场比赛已经结束了。

lines.en: scene black
: But even though the games have finished, the night has not!
lines.zh: : 不过比赛虽然结束了，夜晚还没有！

lines.en: : Relax! Have fun! And make sure to tip your bartender!
lines.zh: : 放松！尽情玩！还有，记得给你的酒保小费！

lines.en: : Oh! And also to vote on the popularity poll, which closes in approximately three hours!
lines.zh: : 哦！还有别忘了投人气票，大约三小时后截止！

lines.en: {i}First Floor: [dorm1war2points]\nSecond Floor: [dorm2war2points]{/i}
lines.zh:
{i}一楼：[dorm1war2points]
二楼：[dorm2war2points]{/i}

lines.en: if utacostumewin == True:
scene actualsecondcostumething21
: Heheh...heh...
: I can’t stop blushing for some reason...
lines.zh: : 不知道为什么，我脸红个不停……

lines.en: : Did you ever doubt that you were going to lose? Because I’ve made my thoughts on Uta-chan very clear.
lines.zh: : 你什么时候怀疑过自己会输吗？毕竟我对 Uta 酱的看法可是表达得很清楚了。

lines.en: : Uta-chan’s been locked away since Friday. Uta {i}Ushibori{/i} won the competition. You even said it yourself.
lines.zh: : Uta 酱从周五起就一直被锁起来了。而赢得比赛的是 Uta {i}Ushibori{/i}。你自己也这么说过。

lines.en: : I guess I didn’t realize how happy that would make me, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我没想到这会让我这么开心。

lines.en: : I wish the same went for Io. She looks a little...serious right now.
lines.zh: : 但愿 Io 也能一样。她现在看起来有点……严肃。

lines.en: : I am serious, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我是认真的，老师。

lines.en: scene actualsecondcostumething22
: Seriously proud of you for making the right decision! Kunoichi Uta was clearly the superior choice! Especially since I can’t smell her from a mile away!
lines.zh: : 我真的为你做出了正确的决定而骄傲！女忍者 Uta 显然是更优的选择！尤其是我还不用在一英里外就闻到她身上的味儿！

lines.en: : Oh, stop. You guys are too nice to me. All I did was play around for a few days. It’s not like I actually expected to {i}win{/i} or anything.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，别这样。你们对我太好了。我这几天不过是闹着玩而已。我根本没指望过自己会{i}赢{/i}什么的。

lines.en: : Tell her how adorable she is.
lines.zh: : 跟她说她有多可爱。

lines.en: : No. It’s weird when {i}you{/i} ask me to do it.
lines.zh: : 不要。{i}你{/i}让我说的时候就很怪。

lines.en: scene actualsecondcostumething23
: Heeeeeey. Congratulations, Uta. You did really well. I think.
lines.zh: : 嘿——嘿。恭喜你，Uta。你表现得非常好。我觉得。

lines.en: : I can’t really remember. But you won, so you must have done better than me.
lines.zh: : 我其实记不太清了。不过你赢了，所以你肯定比我表现得好。

lines.en: : You were great too, Miku. I made Io take a video, so I can show it to you when you’re not high.
lines.zh: : 你也很棒，Miku。我让 Io 录了视频，等你没嗨的时候可以放给你看。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, what?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，你说什么？

lines.en: scene actualsecondcostumething24
: I gave Miku a Valium.
lines.zh: : 我给了 Miku 一片安定。

lines.en: : You {i}what?{/i}
lines.zh: : 你{i}什么？{/i}

lines.en: : What? It worked.
lines.zh: : 怎么？管用就行。

lines.en: : You know that feeling you get when you lay face down on the bed and smush your face into the pillow and can’t breathe, but it’s actually kinda nice in a weird sort of way?
lines.zh: : 你知道那种感觉吗——趴在床上，把脸埋进枕头里，喘不过气来，但奇怪的是竟然还挺舒服的？

lines.en: : That’s me right now.
lines.zh: : 我现在就是那种状态。

lines.en: : Go lay down or something.
lines.zh: : 去躺着吧，或者什么的。

lines.en: : Can you carry me?
lines.zh: : 你能背我吗？

lines.en: : Probably not without being assassinated.
lines.zh: : 大概不行，除非我想被暗杀。

lines.en: scene actualsecondcostumething25
: Kiriiiiiin! Makotooooooo! Somebody carry me! I’m liiiiight!
lines.zh: : Kirin——！Makoto——！谁来背背我！我可——轻了！

lines.en: : Yeah, probably should have cut it in half.
lines.zh: : 是啊，早知道该切一半给她。

lines.en: else:
scene actualsecondcostumething26
: See, Miku! You were worried for nothing! All of that “They’re going to see through me” BS was just BS after all. Sensei obviously likes you the most.
lines.zh: : 看吧，Miku！你白担心了！那些什么「他们会看穿我的」的鬼话，到头来就只是鬼话。老师显然最喜欢你。

lines.en: : Is that true, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 是真的吗，老师？

lines.en: : Do you like me the most?
lines.zh: : 你最喜欢我吗？

lines.en: scene actualsecondcostumething27
: In the context of this one very specific situation, yes. But please do not take those words and carry them around like some sort of trophy as you will likely be killed for it.
lines.zh: : 就这一个非常特定的情境而言，是的。但请不要把这句话当成什么奖杯到处炫耀，不然你很可能会因此被人干掉。

lines.en: : I was really scared, ya know? That you’d go and pick Uta over me. Thought it was guaranteed.
lines.zh: : 我真的好害怕，你知道吗？怕你会选 Uta 不选我。我还以为那是板上钉钉的事。

lines.en: : I still don’t feel right when I look like this.
lines.zh: : 我变成这副样子，还是觉得不对劲。

lines.en: : But if this is the side of me that can make your heart flutter, I think I might be able to deal with it sometimes.
lines.zh: : 但如果这样的我能让你心动，我想我大概偶尔也能接受一下。

lines.en: : Is everything alright? Your voice is a little-
lines.zh: : 你还好吗？你的声音有点——

lines.en: scene actualsecondcostumething28
: Congratulations, Miku. It was a well-fought battle and if there is anything Uta Ushibori knows, it’s how to step aside when someone else is clearly the winner.
lines.zh: : 恭喜你，Miku。这是一场打得漂亮的较量；而如果说 Uta Ushibori 懂什么，那就是当别人显然是赢家时，该如何退到一旁。

lines.en: : Thanks, Uta. I still think you were the right choice, but I’m happy I somehow managed to beat you.
lines.zh: : 谢了，Uta。我还是觉得你才是正确的人选，不过我还是很高兴自己莫名其妙赢了你。

lines.en: : Nonsense! You’re cuter than you give yourself credit for. And I’m not just talkin’ about when you’re all dolled up like that. Normal Miku’s great too.
lines.zh: : 胡说！你比你自己以为的要可爱得多。而且我说的不只是你打扮成这样的时候。平时的 Miku 也很好。

lines.en: : Sucks I wasn’t able to choose both of you. Your costume was great as well, Uta.
lines.zh: : 可惜我不能把你们两个都选上。你的服装也很棒，Uta。

lines.en: scene actualsecondcostumething29
: Just not as great as Miku! Talk to her, not me. I’m just here to spread vibes.
lines.zh: : 只是没 Miku 那么棒！跟她说，别跟我说。我只是来这儿散发气氛的。

lines.en: : Vibes are like, totally my thing now. I finally get what that means.
lines.zh: : 「气氛」现在完全就是我的菜了。我终于明白那是什么意思了。

lines.en: : Aaaand that’s my cue to go back to Io and leave you guys alone for the rest of the night!
lines.zh: : 好——啦，这就是我该回到 Io 身边、今晚剩下的时间不再打扰你们俩的信号！

lines.en: : Have fun, okay?!
lines.zh: : 玩得开心，好吗？！

lines.en: scene actualsecondcostumething30
: Laters, Uta! TTYL! HMU! LOL! NAFTA!
lines.zh: : 回见，Uta！TTYL！HMU！LOL！NAFTA！

lines.en: scene actualsecondcostumething31
: Sup, Kirin? Why’re ya just lookin’ at me like that?
lines.zh: : 咋啦，Kirin？你干嘛就那样盯着我？

lines.en: : Huh? What? I wasn’t.
lines.zh: : 啊？什么？我没有啊。

lines.en: : You think I don’t know when you’re lying by now? Come on.
lines.zh: : 你以为我现在还看不出你在撒谎吗？拜托。

lines.en: : I’ve...got no idea what you’re talking about.
lines.zh: : 我……完全不知道你在说什么。

lines.en: Just then, a sudden tapping on my shoulder forces me to turn around.
lines.zh: 就在这时，肩膀上突然传来一阵轻拍，逼得我转过身去。

lines.en: scene sexyland
scene sexyland2
scene actualsecondcostumething32
: Uhh...
scene actualsecondcostumething33
: You want to go outside?
lines.zh: : 你想去外面？

lines.en: scene actualsecondcostumething32
: Uh...excuse me, you two...but I’ll be right back...
lines.zh: : 呃……失陪一下，你们两位……我马上回来……

lines.en: scene black
scene actualsecondcostumething34
: I don’t have any money.
lines.zh: : 我没钱。

lines.en: : I don’t want your fucking money.
lines.zh: : 我不要你的臭钱。

lines.en: : ...No way.
lines.zh: : ……不会吧。

lines.en: : I know that voice.
lines.zh: : 我认得那个声音。

lines.en: : Do you have a fucking problem, asshole?
lines.zh: : 你有毛病吗，混蛋？

lines.en: : Take off the helmet, Niki.
lines.zh: : 把头盔摘了，Niki。

lines.en: scene actualsecondcostumething35
: {i}You’re{/i} a helmet! Fuck you!
lines.zh: : {i}你才是{/i}头盔！去你的！

lines.en: : I have so many questions, but I will start with one overarching one.
lines.zh: : 我有一大堆问题，不过我先问一个总的。

lines.en: : {i}Why?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}为什么？{/i}

lines.en: : What do you mean {i}why?{/i} Do you seriously think I can just be myself in front of a group of teenage girls when they’re my number one demographic?! Get real!
lines.zh: : 什么叫{i}为什么{/i}？你真以为我能在一群十几岁的女孩面前做自己吗？她们可是我的头号受众！别天真了！

lines.en: : I meant something more along the lines of “Why have you been following me around dressed as a dolphin for two days?”
lines.zh: : 我指的是更接近「为什么你这两天要穿成一只海豚跟着我到处跑？」这种问题。

lines.en: scene actualsecondcostumething36
: I overheard my sister talking about a contest where a bunch of teenage girls fight over you and I wanted to make sure that nothing weird happened.
lines.zh: : 我无意中听到我妹妹说起一场比赛——一群十几岁的女孩为了你争得你死我活，我就想确认一下不会出什么奇怪的事。

lines.en: : So basically, you were jealous.
lines.zh: : 所以基本上，你是吃醋了。

lines.en: scene actualsecondcostumething37
: Yeah. And? What are {i}you{/i} gonna do about it?
lines.zh: : 对。怎么了？{i}你{/i}打算拿我怎么办？

lines.en: : Nothing. I just wish I would have known sooner as I definitely would have chosen you as the winner of the costume contest.
lines.zh: : 什么都不做。我只是希望我能早点知道，那样我肯定会选你当服装比赛的冠军。

lines.en: : Fucking bite me.
lines.zh: : 去你的吧。

lines.en: scene actualsecondcostumething38
: There you are! I heard you-
lines.zh: : 你在这儿啊！我听说你——

lines.en: scene actualsecondcostumething39
scene actualsecondcostumething40
: I heard you went outside and I wanted to come say hi.
lines.zh: : 我听说你出去了，就想过来打个招呼。

lines.en: : No reaction at all to finding out your sister was the mystery dolphin this whole time?
lines.zh: : 发现自己妹妹一直都是那只神秘海豚，你一点反应都没有？

lines.en: scene actualsecondcostumething41
: Not really. She’s the crazy one in the family, not me.
lines.zh: : 没什么。家里发疯的那个人是她，不是我。

lines.en: : Crazy awesome, you mean.
lines.zh: : 你是说，疯得帅气吧。

lines.en: scene actualsecondcostumething42
: I worry for you sometimes, Nee-chan. I really do.
lines.zh: : 我有时候真为你担心，老姐。真的。

lines.en: : Shut up! I still haven’t gotten to say what I dragged him out here for!
lines.zh: : 闭嘴！我还没说我把他拽出来是为了什么呢！

lines.en: : And what’s-
lines.zh: : 那是什么——

lines.en: : Christmas date!
lines.zh: : 圣诞节约会！

lines.en: scene actualsecondcostumething43
: You and me!
lines.zh: : 你和我！

lines.en: scene actualsecondcostumething44
: If you’re going to reject me again, at least do it properly. Don’t just stand there like an idiot. Say something.
lines.zh: : 如果你又要拒绝我，至少像样点。别像个白痴一样杵在那儿。说句话啊。

lines.en: : Niki-
lines.zh: : Niki——

lines.en: : Wait! Before you actually say something, I want to...say {i}more{/i} things!
lines.zh: : 等等！在你真的开口之前，我想……再{i}多{/i}说几句！

lines.en: : Last Christmas...I gave you my heart.
lines.zh: : 去年圣诞节……我把我的心交给了你。

lines.en: : Oof. Bad start.
lines.zh: : 呃。开头就烂。

lines.en: : And within just minutes, you gave it away.
lines.zh: : 而短短几分钟后，你就把它送给了别人。

lines.en: : Nee-chan, come on. You’re better than this.
lines.zh: : 老姐，拜托。你不至于这么差吧。

lines.en: : Noriko, shut the fuck up.
lines.zh: : Noriko，给我闭嘴。

lines.en: : This year-
lines.zh: : 今年——

lines.en: : To save you from tears-
lines.zh: : 为了让你不再流泪——

lines.en: : Yeah! Whatever! This year, I want you to actually accept it.
lines.zh: : 对！管他呢！今年，我要你真的收下它。

lines.en: : That’s not how the song goes.
lines.zh: : 歌词不是这么唱的。

lines.en: scene actualsecondcostumething45
: What the absolute fuck are you even talking about?!
lines.zh: : 你他妈到底在说什么？！

lines.en: : Do you seriously not know it?! You work in the music industry!
lines.zh: : 你该不会真不知道吧？！你可是干音乐这行的！

lines.en: : What did you want to do?
lines.zh: : 你想做什么？

lines.en: scene actualsecondcostumething46
: I don’t care. Literally anything.
lines.zh: : 我不在乎。真的什么都行。

lines.en: : I’m tired of spending Christmas in front of thousands of people I don’t want to be with while the one person I do is off...doing whatever fucking creepy shit you do in your free time.
lines.zh: : 我受够了在上千个我根本不想待在一起的人面前过圣诞节，而我唯一想在一起的那个人却跑去……干你空闲时间干的那堆变态破事。

lines.en: : Even if it’s just hanging out at your place or going to KFC or a movie theatre or...I don’t fucking know. Maybe a gas station or something! Anywhere! I just want a Christmas date!
lines.zh: : 就算只是在你家待着，或者去肯德基、去电影院，又或者……我他妈不知道。也许加油站什么的也行！哪里都行！我只想要一次圣诞节约会！

lines.en: : Me too.
lines.zh: : 我也是。

lines.en: scene actualsecondcostumething47
: Heh? What do you mean “me too?”
lines.zh: : 哈？「我也是」是什么意思？

lines.en: : I mean you had a whole year to get Sensei back and you didn’t. Let me have this Christmas.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，你有一整年的时间把老师追回来，结果你没做到。这个圣诞节就让给我吧。

lines.en: : Uhh...how about no? Stop hitting on my ex. It’s creepy.
lines.zh: : 呃……我拒绝怎么样？别再勾引我前任了。很恶心。

lines.en: : Pick me instead, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 选我吧，老师……

lines.en: : Go on a Christmas date with me this year. Not Niki.
lines.zh: : 今年和我过一次圣诞节约会吧。不是 Niki。

lines.en: : Is this a joke?
lines.zh: : 这是在开玩笑吗？

lines.en: It suddenly becomes apparent that I need to make one {i}more{/i} important decision...
lines.zh: 我突然意识到，我还得{i}再{/i}做一个重要的决定……

lines.en: It’s one I didn’t expect to make after the conclusion of the contest, but-
lines.zh: 这个决定我没料到会在比赛结束之后才要去做，不过——

lines.en: scene actualsecondcostumething48
: Oh, shit. I think someone’s coming.
lines.zh: : 哦，糟了。好像有人来了。

lines.en: : Oh, you’ve gotta be fucking kidding me.
lines.zh: : 哦，你他妈在逗我吧。

lines.en: scene actualsecondcostumething49
: Hey. What are you doing with Noriko and the dolphin?
lines.zh: : 嘿。你跟 Noriko 和那只海豚在干什么？

lines.en: : Just...talking about Christmas.
lines.zh: : 只是……聊聊圣诞节。

lines.en: : Oh, that reminds me. Do you have any plans that day?
lines.zh: : 哦，这倒提醒我了。你那天有什么安排吗？

lines.en: {i}Oh no.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}哦不。{/i}

lines.en: scene black
{i}Meanwhile...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}与此同时……{/i}

lines.en: scene actualsecondcostumething50
: Why, hello. I don’t believe we’ve met.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，你好。我想我们还没见过面。

lines.en: : My name is Nodoka Nagasawa — writer, inventor, entrepreneur...and very good with my fingers.
lines.zh: : 我叫 Nodoka Nagasawa——作家、发明家、创业者……而且手指非常灵活。

lines.en: : Really? Do you play guitar?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？你会弹吉他？

lines.en: : I do not.
lines.zh: : 不会。

lines.en: : Piano?
lines.zh: : 钢琴？

lines.en: : Guess again.
lines.zh: : 再猜。

lines.en: : Violin?
lines.zh: : 小提琴？

lines.en: : Cello?
lines.zh: : 大提琴？

lines.en: : I’m flirting with you.
lines.zh: : 我在跟你调情。

lines.en: : Oooooh.
lines.zh: : 哦——哦哦。

lines.en: : Why? You’re a kid. Go find someone your own age.
lines.zh: : 为什么？你还是个孩子。去找个跟你年纪相仿的吧。

lines.en: : All the girls my own age are boring. What I want is someone like you...someone with {i}experience.{/i}
lines.zh: : 跟我同年纪的女孩都很无聊。我想要的是像你这样的人……一个{i}有经验{/i}的人。

lines.en: : Pay her no mind, Rika. If being socially inept equates to having a few screws loose in the head, Nagasawa’s is fully detached and still in the box.
lines.zh: : 别理她，Rika。如果说社交无能等于脑袋里少几颗螺丝，那 Nagasawa 那颗已经彻底掉下来、还留在包装盒里呢。

lines.en: : What do you say? Do you want to get out of here?
lines.zh: : 你觉得怎么样？想不想离开这儿？

lines.en: : And do what? Get you into an R-rated movie?
lines.zh: : 然后干什么？带你去看限制级电影？

lines.en: : Or my pants. Whichever is more fun for you.
lines.zh: : 或者进我的裤子。看你觉得哪个更有趣。

lines.en: : Hey. Stop hanging all over the customers or I’ll throw you the fuck out of here.
lines.zh: : 喂。别再往客人身上贴了，不然我他妈把你扔出去。

lines.en: : But the other couple beside us have been hanging all over each other the whole night.
lines.zh: : 可我们旁边那对情侣整晚都黏在一起啊。

lines.en: : Yes, but we’re in a committed relationship and that is Rin’s mom.
lines.zh: : 是，可我们是稳定的情侣关系，而且那是 Rin 的妈妈。

lines.en: : Is that so? Well, seeing as I sleep just ten feet away from Rin’s girlfriend...perhaps we’ll be seeing each other more often?
lines.zh: : 是吗？既然我睡的地方离 Rin 的女朋友只有十英尺……也许我们以后会经常见面？

lines.en: : Probably not. There’s definitely no reason I would ever be near your dorms, so the chances of us ever seeing each other again basically don’t exist.
lines.zh: : 大概不会。我绝对没有任何理由会靠近你们宿舍，所以我们再碰面的概率基本等于零。

lines.en: : A one night stand it is, then.
lines.zh: : 那就来一夜情吧。

lines.en: : Yo, creepy kimono girl, let her go or I seriously will toss you the fuck out of here.
lines.zh: : 喂，诡异和服妹，放开她，不然我真把你扔出去。

lines.en: : Yuki, Yuki...be gentle with me. I’m fragile.
lines.zh: : Yuki，Yuki……对我温柔点。我很脆弱的。

lines.en: : How the fuck do you know my name?
lines.zh: : 你他妈怎么知道我的名字？

lines.en: : We met at the gym, remember? I asked you if you were into younger women.
lines.zh: : 我们在健身房见过，记得吗？我问过你喜不喜欢年轻一点的女性。

lines.en: : Oh...Yeah, that tracks.
lines.zh: : 哦……对，说得通。

lines.en: : Doesn’t change shit, though. Leave her alone or you’re getting tossed out.
lines.zh: : 不过这改变不了什么。离她远点，不然我就把你扔出去。

lines.en: : How many more Yamaguchis must I fend off before I find true love? Find out in my next book, “The MILF with the Dragon Tattoo.”
lines.zh: : 我还要挡下多少个 Yamaguchi 家的人，才能找到真爱？答案请见我的下一本书——《龙纹身的 MILF》。

lines.en: scene actualsecondcostumething51
: More?
lines.zh: : 还有？

lines.en: : Wait a second...you the one who got the shit kicked out of her by my daughter?
lines.zh: : 等等……你就是那个被我女儿打得半死的人？

lines.en: : Guilty as charged. She packs quite a punch. I wonder where all of the strength comes from?
lines.zh: : 认罪。她拳头的力道真不小。我倒是好奇，那份力气是从哪儿来的？

lines.en: : You been fuckin’ with her? Cause we ain't the type to attack people without a reason.
lines.zh: : 你一直在招惹她吗？因为我们可不是那种无缘无故就动手的人。

lines.en: : Me? Do I really seem that threatening?
lines.zh: : 我？我真有那么吓人吗？

lines.en: : No. But you seem like a fucking creep. And if you’re going out of the way to fuck with Yumi-
lines.zh: : 不。但你看起来就是个该死的变态。而且如果你非要费劲去招惹 Yumi——

lines.en: : Aunt Yukiburger! Stop it right now!
lines.zh: : Yukiburger 阿姨！快住手！

lines.en: scene actualsecondcostumething52
: The first rule of customer service is that the customer is always a customer! Which means that the words we say to them have to be good ones! Round ones! Like a big, rubber ball!
lines.zh: : 客服的第一条铁律是：顾客永远是顾客！也就是说，我们对他们说的话必须是好话！圆润的话！就像一颗大大的橡皮球！

lines.en: : Come again?
lines.zh: : 你说什么？

lines.en: : Use your mouth muscle to make the customer happy!
lines.zh: : 用你的嘴巴肌肉让顾客开心！

lines.en: : Yes. Please do that.
lines.zh: : 对。请务必这么做。

lines.en: : Kaori, this girl’s trying to start problems with our family.
lines.zh: : Kaori，这丫头在找我们家的麻烦。

lines.en: : Problems are meant for solving! And if you strike a problem with your arm foot, the problem goes to the Yelp and gives you two stars and says you are confusing! And that you make them feel strange!
lines.zh: : 麻烦就是用来解决的！而如果你用「手臂脚」去打麻烦，麻烦就会跑到 Yelp 上给你两颗星，还说你让人困惑！还说你让他们觉得很怪！

lines.en: : And that your spider tattoo is too large and it intimidates children!
lines.zh: : 还说你的蜘蛛纹身太大，吓到小孩了！

lines.en: : I don’t need you babysittin’ me, you know. I can make my own fuckin’ decisions.
lines.zh: : 我不需要你管我，知道吗。我自己的决定我自己他妈会做。

lines.en: scene actualsecondcostumething53
: Do not use that tone of speaktalk with me, young ladywoman. Go to the place you fall asleep at night.
lines.zh: : 别用那种「说话腔」跟我讲话，年轻女士。回你晚上睡觉的地方去。

lines.en: : You can’t ground me. I’m older than you.
lines.zh: : 你禁不了我的足。我比你大。

lines.en: : The joke is on top of you, Aunt Yukiburger. You are already {i}on the ground.{/i}
lines.zh: : 笑话在你头上呢，Yukiburger 阿姨。你已经{i}「在地上了」{/i}。

lines.en: : She’s got a point, Yuki.
lines.zh: : 她说得有道理，Yuki。

lines.en: scene actualsecondcostumething54
: No she doesn’t. You’re just a fucking idiot.
lines.zh: : 不，她没道理。你就是个该死的蠢货。

lines.en: : Hey! Big rubber ball words, please! I’m a customer too! I deserve your...mouth muscle- wow, is it just me, or is that kind of lewd?
lines.zh: : 嘿！请用大大的橡皮球话！我也是顾客！我也配得上你的……嘴巴肌肉——哇，是我多想了吗，还是这听起来有点下流？

lines.en: : So...Mrs. Rokuhara...or is it {i}Miss-{/i}
lines.zh: : 那么……Rokuhara 太太……还是该叫{i}小姐{/i}——

lines.en: : AAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHHHH!!!!!!!!!!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！！！！！！

lines.en: : And now she’s crying again. Great.
lines.zh: : 然后她又哭了。好极了。

lines.en: scene black
: Perhaps I’ll just go read.
lines.zh: : 也许我还是去看书吧。

lines.en: if mikucostumewin == True:
scene actualsecondcostumething55
: Uta? What’s wrong? What happened?
lines.zh: : Uta？怎么了？发生什么事了？

lines.en: : I’m so stupid...I’m so stupid...I’m so stupid...
lines.zh: : 我好蠢……我好蠢……我好蠢……

lines.en: : You’re not...You’re wonderful...And there are many people who would be in tatters seeing you this way.
lines.zh: : 你不蠢……你很棒……而看到你这样，会有很多人心碎的。

lines.en: : No, I am! I’m stupid for getting upset over something like this when it’s not even a big deal and I’m stupid for being jealous and...I’m just stupid in general!
lines.zh: : 不，我就是蠢！我为这种根本不算什么的事难过就是蠢，我会嫉妒也是蠢，而且……我总之就是蠢！

lines.en: : Is this...about the contest?
lines.zh: : 这是……因为比赛的事吗？

lines.en: scene actualsecondcostumething56
: I really wanted to win...
lines.zh: : 我真的很想赢……

lines.en: : I told myself I wasn’t going to cry if I didn’t but now I’m crying and a loser and just flat out stupid!
lines.zh: : 我明明跟自己说好输了也不哭，可现在我在哭，我是个输家，而且就是彻头彻尾的蠢！

lines.en: : Uta, please stop talking down on yourself. It won’t make anything better.
lines.zh: : Uta，请别再说贬低自己的话了。那不会让任何事情变好。

lines.en: : I can’t help it...
lines.zh: : 我控制不住……

lines.en: : I tried so hard...making this costume...I even helped Io put the plates together...
lines.zh: : 我那么努力……做这套服装……我甚至还帮 Io 把那些甲片拼起来……

lines.en: : It was really difficult...and I kept pinching myself when I tried to put the rivet thingies in and it hurt and it took forever and now I just want to cry and go home.
lines.zh: : 真的很难……我装那些铆钉的时候老夹到自己的肉，好疼，而且花了好久好久，现在我只想哭，想回家。

lines.en: : Forgive me if this is too forward of a question, but...how do you feel about our teacher, Uta?
lines.zh: : 如果这个问题太过直接，请原谅我，不过……你对我们的老师是什么感觉，Uta？

lines.en: : {i}Sniff...{/i}
: I don’t know...
lines.zh: : 我不知道……

lines.en: : You and I both know that is not true...
lines.zh: : 你我都清楚，那不是真的……

lines.en: : Mm-mm...
scene black
: It’s only true if I say it out loud...
lines.zh: : 只要我不说出来，它就不算真的……
